stories.title: Barring setbacks, Bucs QB Baker Mayfield expected to start vs. Panthers
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield expects to return from a thumb injury, barring any setbacks, and play when the Buccaneers face the Panthers on Sunday.
stories.detail: TAMPA, Fla. -- Barring any setbacks, the expectation is that Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield will return Sunday after a three-week absence due to a dislocated right thumb suffered in Week 3. The Bucs, currently sitting at 1-5, begin divisional play at the Carolina Panthers (3-2). Mayfield was a full participant in Wednesday's and Thursday's practices and the Bucs' communications staff even delayed its weekly quarterback media availability from Wednesday to Thursday to get a better sense of the team's direction. That's when Mayfield walked in, speaking publicly for the first time since suffering the injury. Mayfield said he felt "very confident" in his ability to grip the ball and that while there was some degree of tendon and ligament damage, he believes that with rest and giving the wound time to heal (he did not undergo surgery but the dislocation created a wound that required stitches) he has "gotten to a place where it's strong enough to be able to play" and "feels good." Mayfield has been practicing with a specially made glove on his right hand that has a pad on the back side of the thumb to protect it from bending backward again. It contains metal for reinfor…

stories.title: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet activated off PUP list
stories.summary: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet, who has yet to play this season after scoring 12 TDs in 2025, has been activated off the PUP list and added to the 53-man roster.
stories.detail: RENTON, Wash. -- The Seattle Seahawks activated running back Zach Charbonnet off the physically unable to perform list Thursday, an expected move amid his comeback from a torn ACL. It's not certain that Charbonnet, who is only eight months removed from surgery, will make his season debut Sunday night when the Seahawks host the Kansas City Chiefs at Lumen Field. Coach Mike Macdonald said earlier this week that it's a "possibility" that he plays "in some capacity." "Just taking it a day at a time," Charbonnet said Thursday in his first comments to reporters since he was injured in January. "But whenever I'm out there, it's going to be special and I'm just going to be happy to get back out there." The Seahawks on Thursday also placed second-year tight end Elijah Arroyo on injured reserve. A source told ESPN's Adam Schefter that Arroyo, a 2025 second-round pick who caught one pass for 17 yards in six games this season, is having season-ending surgery to repair a shoulder injury he suffered last week in a loss to the Denver Broncos . stories.title: Ravens' Humphrey expresses displeasure over 'slander' against QB Jackson
stories.summary: Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey voiced his displeasure over what he called "slander" against quarterback Lamar Jackson.
stories.detail: OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- Baltimore Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey voiced his displeasure over what he called "slander" against quarterback Lamar Jackson . On Thursday, Humphrey went on a tangent after being asked how Jackson looked at practice. Jackson returned to the field this week after missing the last two games with a left ankle injury. "It seems like Lamar's the only quarterback kind of gets the slander that he gets for anytime anything is going on," Humphrey said. "I feel like you just don't see these same articles. I'm in the hot tub and it's this, that and the third. Unfair treatment." Humphrey was asked if he was referring to injury "slander," but he didn't clarify. Humphrey then said, "I just feel like sometimes it seems like it gets away from ... I don't know if it's because of lack of agent or what, that no one can kind of defend him. But I do know this, if Lamar Jackson can play, if he's healthy enough to play, he will play, and that's kind of all I can say for that." When asked again exactly what he meant, Humphrey replied, "Whatever I said is whatever I said. You can take it however you want." stories.title: Seahawks activate RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list before facing Chiefs, Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III
stories.summary: Walker has outrushed Seattle by himself, leading the NFL in rushing yards with Kansas City.
stories.detail: The Seattle Seahawks’ rushing attack could get some major help for Week 7’s matchup with the Kansas City Chiefs. Running back Zach Charbonnet was activated from the physically unable to perform list, the team announced on Thursday . He has not played this season due to a torn ACL he sustained during a divisional playoff game versus the San Francisco 49ers in January. The Seahawks go into Sunday’s game with the 14th-ranked rushing attack in the NFL at 643 yards in six games. That number might especially sting when considering that Kenneth Walker III has outrushed Seattle by himself with 665 yards in one fewer game, leading the NFL in that category. Walker earned Super Bowl MVP honors for the Seahawks last season with 131 rushing yards in the 29-13 win over the New England Patriots. But he went on to sign with the Chiefs as a free agent and has changed Kansas City’s offense to more of a power-running attack. Emanuel Wilson leads the Seahawks in rushing so far this season with 303 yards and 2 touchdowns on 87 carries. stories.title: NBA Referees Association weighs in on LaMelo Ball's traveling no-call
stories.summary: The National Basketball Referees Association (NBRA) responded to the controversial traveling no-call by Minnesota Timberwolves guard LaMelo Ball.
stories.detail: The National Basketball Referees Association (NBRA), the official union of NBA officials, responded to the controversial traveling no-call by Minnesota Timberwolves guard LaMelo Ball , indicating that it should have been ruled as an infraction. “For everyone asking, ‘how is this legal?’ It’s not!” the NBRA posted Thursday, Oct. 22 from its social media account. “He gathers with his right foot on the floor and would be permitted two steps by rule (left-right). He takes four steps after gathering the ball and travels.” The play occurred with 8:19 left in the second quarter of Minnesota’s game against the Miami Heat . With the game tied at 39, Ball slipped past a screen toward the right side of the floor. Ball picked up his dribble and then took a gather step by shuffling to his right. The issue is that Ball then took four lateral steps before beginning his shooting motion. He would go on to lace the 3-pointer, one of his five successful conversions on the night. For everyone asking, “how is this legal?” It’s not! He gathers with his right foot on the floor and would be permitted two steps by rule (left-right). stories.title: President Trump criticizes 76ers' LeBron James for actions amid national anthem
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has accused LeBron James of disrespecting the U.S. after the 76ers star appeared to continue his warmups during the national anthem.
stories.detail: President Donald Trump on Thursday accused LeBron James of disrespecting the United States after the 76ers star appeared to continue his warmups while the national anthem was performed before Philadelphia's season opener Tuesday against the Knicks in New York. James appeared to practice a golf swing and jump shot during "The Star-Spangled Banner" at Madison Square Garden. James, in his debut for the 76ers, was lined up alongside teammates who mostly stood still during the anthem. "I said right from the beginning that he's no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE," Trump said of James in a social media post sharing the video. "LeBron James should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag, and all that our Country stands for!" Representatives for James did not respond to requests for comment from ESPN. James, 41, in his record-24th NBA season, was set to make his home debut for the Sixers on Thursday night against Cleveland . Trump himself also has been criticized for his actions during the national anthem. Mandatory Copyright Notice: Copyright 2026 NBAE (Photos by Michael Gonzales/NBAE via Getty Images) | NBAE via Getty Images The Spurs are tied for last place with a bunch of bad teams. Other winless teams the Spurs are tied with include the Bulls, Bucks, Nets, Pelicans, Suns and Kings. Not a group to be associated with. The Spurs are also tied with the “world champion New York Knicks”. Feels odd to write those words after 53 years. And because of Tuesday’s night’s game, the Spurs main rival is undefeated on the season. And yes, the Spurs’ best player had a dreadful offensive game against the Thunder. Near the end of the second quarter, I asked my friend who was watching the game with me, “Does Victor have a basket yet?” The answer was “no”. And he didn’t actually make a “shot” all night – his one…
